errors.evidence: The description claims that the bars follow a fixed order according to the legend. This is incorrect. The order of bars in the chart groups (DAPO, DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, SRPO, PPO, PPO+Self-reflection) is different from the order of items in the legend (DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, etc., reading down the columns).

The description states the accuracy for DAPO in the Physics category is approximately 57.5%. However, the corresponding bar (light blue, hatched) is clearly above the 58% line, at approximately 58.5%.

The description states the accuracy for PPO in the Physics category is approximately 56.9%. The corresponding bar (light green, hatched) is visibly above the midpoint between 56% and 58%, at approximately 57.3%.

errors.text_span: the bars are grouped by benchmark with the same left-to-right method order repeated in each group, and no bars appear stacked or specially annotated beyond the hatch patterns.
errors.evidence: The description of the bar order within the groups is incorrect. The order of the third and fourth bars is consistently SRPO (solid orange) then GRPO (striped orange), not the other way around as implied by the ordering in the legend description (DAPO, DAPO+SR, SRPO, GRPO...). The actual order is DAPO, DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, GRPO, PPO, PPO+Self-reflection.

The description incorrectly states the order of the last two bars in each group. It lists "PPO" (striped bar) before "PPO+Self-reflection" (solid bar). However, in the chart, the solid green bar ("PPO+Self-reflection") is the 5th bar and the striped green bar ("PPO") is the 6th bar in each group.
The description identifies the color of the PPO bar as turquoise ("türkis"), but it is clearly green in the chart.
